parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen of the display, primarily made of glass with a rectangular shape and smooth surface.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main visual interface for displaying images, videos, and data output from connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed and does not move independently, though it may tilt slightly depending on the stand design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic, circular in shape, and supports the screen.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and balance to the display, ensuring it stands upright on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base may allow limited rotation or tilt adjustment of the screen but remains stationary during normal use.
